We consider ourselves to be an integral part of global health care as a leading producer of eggs and related biological media , which are used for the production of human and veterinary vaccines as well as for pharmaceutical research. As a result, we have a special responsibility with regard to the safety and quality of our products and their availability, which we actively embrace. In the past ten years alone, we have invested more than 120 million euros in our global production infrastructure, software, and quality management . Today, we supply our customers from a global production network , ensuring that we combine the advantages of local production (such as local service, short transport routes) with the security of supply of an international network. On the one hand, we contribute to the health of poultry stocks worldwide . At the same time, we bear responsibility for those animals in our care . Supported by modern, digital data acquisition, we are working together to continuously fine-tune processes along the entire production chain and steadily reduce the use of resources for each final vaccine dose.
